body:
The E2E suite runs single-threaded (~190s) but is subprocess-bound: 640 CLI
invocations each pay ~232ms of Python startup. Tests are independent (each uses
its own TemporaryDirectory), so they parallelize safely. Add a stdlib-only
ProcessPoolExecutor runner (scripts/tests/run_parallel.py) that loads the test
module once per worker and distributes test ids. Measured ~1.9x on a 4-core Pi
(190s -> 104s); flattens past 2 workers due to fork/exec contention. Preserves
full end-to-end fidelity (still runs the real gittoc binary).
title: add stdlib parallel test runner to speed up the suite
